detail.title: Unprompted Complexity Growth: Hypothesis Formulation
detail.summary: This cycle initiates hypothesis development for the unprompted complexity growth project, focusing on adaptive feedback loops as a mechanism for emergent behavior. As search slots are currently exhausted and existing evidence is insufficient for synthesis, this hypothesis frames an empirical path forward for future experiment cycles.
